summary: So today @mozilla and @mozlearn have announced the sunsetting of #Thimble, this is the last of the webmaker properties to go extinct. The #teachtheweb era comes to a close and a new future dawns. h/t to all those involved in hackasaurus, webmaker, and whatever the hell we ever decided the name was before the entire project got shuttered.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: So today @mozilla and @mozlearn have announced the sunsetting of #Thimble, this is the last of the webmaker properties to go extinct. The #teachtheweb era comes to a close and a new future dawns. h/t to all those involved in hackasaurus, webmaker, and whatever the hell we ever decided the name was before the entire project got shuttered.
